_readme: Who counts as staff, and the weekly competitions staff win no prizes in (pack-odds-2026-09 PLAN.md 5.2 and 7.2: staff are ineligible for
test-week prizes). Loaded at server start and validated strictly (an invalid file stops the server).
Staff are the verified Discord accounts the operator panel lets through maintenance (player_access.maintenance_bypass, migration 063) when
maintenanceBypassIsStaff is true, plus discordIds; a club is theirs when its persona is derived from one of those ids. Discord bypass roles
are asked of Discord at launch and not stored, so a staff member let in only by a role must be listed here or on the panel's bypass list.
prizesIneligibleIn: rivals, weekendLeague and/or squadBattles. A staff club is left out of such a competition when it settles, if the
competition ends at or before prizesIneligibleUntil (ISO 8601 UTC; null = always): it gets no prize, and its place, percentile and band
pass to the players below it. The live standings still show it. 2026-10-12T00:00:00Z covers the test week: Rivals week 2961, Weekend
League 2961 and the Squad Battles weeks ending 5 and 12 October.
Empty since 2026-09-29 (owner: staff count): staff win prizes like everyone else. List competitions here to exclude them again.
